visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing an olive green shirt stands in a studio setting. Behind him is a bright pink and blue neon sign that reads 'TAIWAN BAR' and shelves filled with various liquor bottles. He holds a black bear plush toy with cartoonish angry eyebrows attached. Yellow and white text overlays appear at the bottom. (2) The scene cuts to a yellow vintage television set placed on a wooden surface next to a pile of golden-brown french fries on a bed-like textile. The TV screen displays a static signal. (3) The man returns to the screen, gesturing with his hands as he speaks animatedly. A graphic bubble with a cartoon face appears next to the bear plush. (4) A shot from behind a professional camera operator shows them filming a stage with bright spotlights in the distance. The man's narration continues over this B-roll footage. (5) A SMPTE color bars glitch transition occurs, momentarily filling the frame with vertical colored stripes and digital noise. (6) An extreme close-up shot shows a hand moving a magnifying glass over an old book with printed text, focusing on specific lines. (7) A cinematic, warm-lit shot features an elderly woman with grey hair in a kitchen/dining room. She is smiling and carrying a white platter with a large, garnished roasted chicken. (8) Back to the man in the studio, he holds the black bear plush and points towards the viewer. A colorful graphic for '客客客棧' (Hakka Hostel) appears at the bottom with a landscape illustration.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 歷史老師真的問什麼都答得出來嗎. [Logo]: @臺灣吧 TAIWAN BAR. (2) [Subtitle]: 欸老湯 為什麼大家都說客家人很小氣. [Variety]: 我真的好不爽喔. (3) [Subtitle]: 這一切都跟媒體有關. (4) [Subtitle]: 什麼意思. (5) [Subtitle]: 在20世紀後半年 臺灣迎來了一個電視的黃金年代. (6) [Subtitle]: 其中一些客家的藝人 為了要彰顯自己的獨特性. (7) [Subtitle]: 把本來的勤勞節儉 用小氣這種尖銳的方式凸顯出來去創造效果. (8) [Subtitle]: 久而久之就連結了 小氣＝客家人這樣的印象. (9) [Subtitle]: 你覺得客家人勤勞節儉嗎. (10) [Subtitle]: 我阿婆是蠻節儉的啦. (11) [Subtitle]: 客委會也有做一個 大規模的調查. (12) [Subtitle]: 發現多數的客家人認同 勤勞節儉是客家人的特質. (13) [Subtitle]: 我就記得我阿婆 對客人都很大方. (14) [Subtitle]: 好客的文化. (15) [Slogan]: 客客客棧 了解客家的奧秘.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian male with short black hair, wearing an olive-green button-down shirt, presenting in a casual yet professional studio manner.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, medium-tempo synth and percussion BGM kicks in. A male voice speaks with high energy and professional clarity. A secondary female voice, acting as the plush bear, sounds frustrated. A sharp 'ding' SFX punctuates the opening question. (2) A digital static glitch SFX plays during the screen transition. (3) The male narration continues, explaining historical context with a rhythmic, educational cadence. BGM remains constant in the background. (4) A comedic 'pop' sound occurs as a graphic appears. (5) A dramatic transition whoosh SFX follows. (6) During the culinary cutaway, the BGM remains but the vocal tone becomes slightly warmer and more inviting. (7) A final stinger SFX ends the audio track with a clean fade-out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Myth Debunking -> Historical Origin -> Statistical Evidence -> Synthesis -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To debunk the cultural stereotype that Hakka people are stingy by explaining its origins in 20th-century mass media and contrasting it with the traditional value of hospitality, while promoting the 'Hakka Hostel' series.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct verbal call to search for the brand name '客客客棧' (Hakka Hostel) and prominent visual display of the series logo.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A highly polished infotainment piece characteristic of Taiwan Bar, utilizing fast-paced editing, motion graphics, and a bar-themed persona to make cultural history engaging for a younger audience.
